segs.en: C. Unjob Search

zh.ai: C. 非工作搜索

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf18d3cd4ad34624266b773e5efcbe2717ae2718.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf18d3cd4ad34624266b773e5efcbe2717ae2718.png)

segs.en: Aram got bored of having a job, so he quit and went off to the distant country of Lalaland.

zh.ai: Aram 厌倦了工作，于是辞职前往遥远的 Lalaland。

segs.en: Lalaland has $$$N$$$ cities with unexciting names of $$$1, 2,\ldots, N$$$. There are $$$N-1$$$ rail lines connecting pairs of cities, making it possible to get from any city to any other. In other words, Lalaland is a tree.

zh.ai: Lalaland 有 $$$N$$$ 座城市，它们的名字都是 $$$1, 2,\ldots, N$$$。有 $$$N-1$$$ 条铁路连接着成对的城市，使得任意一座城市都可以到达任意另一座城市。换句话说，Lalaland 是一棵树。

segs.en: Lalaland has something called an unjob. Unjobs are similar to jobs, except that people who have an unjob can't be fired, have no obligations, and don't get paid. This is exactly what Aram is looking for so he can prove theorems all day long.

zh.ai: Lalaland 有一种叫作 unjob 的东西。unjob 与工作类似，但拥有 unjob 的人不会被解雇，没有任何义务，也不会获得报酬。这正是 Aram 想要的，这样他就能整天证明定理了。

segs.en: The Lalaland government knows that the general public views these unjobs as somewhat unsavory, and they may also be attracting large numbers of foreigners into the country. Hence they passed a law requiring people with unjobs to live in faraway terminal cities: cities that are only connected to one rail line. The government hoped that this would keep people with unjobs far away from the center of their country.

zh.ai: Lalaland 政府知道，公众认为这些非正式工作有些不体面，而且它们可能还吸引了大量外国人入境。因此，政府通过了一项法律，要求从事非正式工作的人居住在偏远的终点城市中：这类城市只与一条铁路相连。政府希望借此让从事非正式工作的人远离国家中心。

segs.en: Aram wants to go to a terminal city. Having never been to Lalaland, he asked his cosmopolitan friend David if he knows of a terminal city. David said no, but claimed to have travelled between every pair of cities of Lalaland and can remember if any given city was on the unique shortest sequence of rail lines between them. He lets Aram ask up to $$$N$$$ questions of the following form:

zh.ai: 阿拉姆想去一座终点城市。由于从未去过 Lalaland，他便询问见多识广的朋友大卫是否知道一座终点城市。大卫说不知道，但声称自己曾往返于 Lalaland 的每一对城市之间，并且记得给定的某座城市是否位于它们之间唯一的最短铁路线路上。他允许阿拉姆提出最多 $$$N$$$ 个如下形式的问题：

segs.en: "For cities $$$a$$$, $$$b$$$, and $$$c$$$, do you pass by city $$$b$$$ as you travel along the shortest path from $$$a$$$ to $$$c$$$?"

zh.ai: 对于城市 $$$a$$$、$$$b$$$ 和 $$$c$$$，当你沿着从 $$$a$$$ 到 $$$c$$$ 的最短路径行进时，会经过城市 $$$b$$$ 吗？

segs.en: If Aram asks more than $$$N$$$ questions, David will get tired and take a nap for who knows how long. Help Aram quickly find a terminal city!

zh.ai: 如果 Aram 提出超过 $$$N$$$ 个问题，David 会感到疲惫并打个不知要睡多久的盹。请帮助 Aram 快速找到一个终端城市！

segs.en: Interaction

zh.ai: 交互

segs.en: The first line of input from the judge contains a single integer $$$N$$$ ($$$3\le N \le 2\,000$$$), the number of cities in Lalaland.

zh.ai: 评测机输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$N$$$($$$3\le N \le 2\,000$$$)，表示 Lalaland 的城市数量。

segs.en: Following this, you may submit up to $$$N$$$ queries of the following forms:

zh.ai: 在此之后，你最多可以提交 $$$N$$$ 次以下形式的查询：

segs.en: ? a b c — ($$$1\le a, b, c \le N$$$) which asks if city $$$b$$$ will be visited while taking the shortest set of rail lines from city $$$a$$$ to city $$$c$$$.

zh.ai: ? a b c — ($$$1\le a, b, c \le N$$$)，它询问从城市 $$$a$$$ 到城市 $$$c$$$ 的最短铁路线路中是否会经过城市 $$$b$$$。

segs.en: The judge will respond with either $$$1$$$ indicating that city $$$b$$$ is indeed between cities $$$a$$$ and $$$c$$$, or $$$0$$$ indicating that it is not.

zh.ai: 评测程序会回复 $$$1$$$，表示城市 $$$b$$$ 确实位于城市 $$$a$$$ 和城市 $$$c$$$ 之间；或者回复 $$$0$$$，表示并非如此。

segs.en: At any time, you may submit an answer in the following form:

zh.ai: 在任意时刻，你都可以按照以下格式提交答案：

segs.en: ! x ($$$1\le x \le N$$$) — which means your program claims that $$$x$$$ is a terminal city.

zh.ai: ! x ($$$1\le x \le N$$$) ——这意味着你的程序声称 $$$x$$$ 是一座终点城市。

segs.en: After answering, your program must terminate immediately to get a verdict. Failing to follow this interaction protocol may result in unexpected errors.

zh.ai: 回答后，程序必须立即终止以获得判定结果。不遵守此交互协议可能导致意外错误。

segs.en: If your input is malformed, the judge will output -1. Upon reading -1 your program should exit immediately to get a wrong answer verdict, otherwise you may get another error.

zh.ai: 如果你的输入格式错误，评测器将输出 -1。读到 -1 后，你的程序应立即退出以获得答案错误的判定，否则可能会出现其他错误。

segs.en: Please be sure to use the stream flushing operation after each query in order not to leave part of your output in the buffer. For example, in C++ you can use fflush(stdout) or end with cout <{}< endl or cout <{}< flush. In Java you can use System.out.flush(). In Python, you can use stdout.flush().

zh.ai: 请务必在每次查询后刷新输出流，以免部分输出仍留在缓冲区中。例如，在 C++ 中可以使用 fflush(stdout)，或者以 cout <{}< endl 或 cout <{}< flush 结束。在 Java 中可以使用 System.out.flush()。在 Python 中可以使用 stdout.flush()。

segs.en: The sample has two terminal cities, $$$1$$$ and $$$3$$$. Either answer would be accepted.

zh.ai: 样例中有两个终点城市：$$$1$$$ 和 $$$3$$$。输出其中任意一个答案都可以通过。

segs.en: D. Astrodirections

zh.ai: D. 天体方向

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73293382c761872c60d3606b5122e613a7645e9f.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73293382c761872c60d3606b5122e613a7645e9f.png)

segs.en: It is a very rare event that all $$$N$$$ colonized planets in the galaxy, numbered $$$1,2,\ldots,N$$$, align in order on a straight line. To celebrate the occasion, a grand Astrofestival is held on one of the planets, where unhealthy amounts of Astrohol will be consumed.

zh.ai: 在银河系中，所有编号为 $$$1,2,\ldots,N$$$ 的 $$$N$$$ 个殖民行星依次排列在一条直线上，这是一件极其罕见的事情。为庆祝这一时刻，一场盛大的 Astrofestival 将在其中一颗行星上举行，届时人们将饮用数量惊人的 Astrohol。

segs.en: Astrodavid doesn't know what Astrohol is, but he's very excited about the Astrogeometry meetup that will take place at the Astrofestival. Unfortunately, he doesn't know on which planet it's held. He may Astrojump between planets on his Astroship, but he has to buy fuel first. Luckily, he reached the fuel station on his home planet just before it closes for the Astrofestival. How much fuel must Astrodavid buy to guarantee that he'll make it to the Astrofestival?

zh.ai: Astrodavid 不知道 Astrohol 是什么，但他对将在 Astrofestival 举办的 Astrogeometry 聚会感到非常兴奋。遗憾的是，他不知道聚会会在哪颗行星上举行。他可以乘坐自己的 Astroship 在行星之间进行 Astrojump，但必须先购买燃料。幸运的是，在 Astrofestival 开始前，家乡行星上的加油站即将关闭时，他及时赶到了。为了确保自己能赶到 Astrofestival，Astrodavid 必须购买多少燃料？

segs.en: Astrodavid lives on planet $$$1$$$. His Astroship has jump power $$$J$$$. To take off from planet $$$p$$$, he chooses an Astrojump displacement $$$i$$$ such $$$1\le |i|\le J$$$, $$$1\le p+i\le N$$$, and his fuel supply is at least $$$f_i$$$ units. He will then land on planet $$$p+i$$$, his fuel supply having decreased by $$$f_i$$$ units. Upon asking for directions there, he'll know if the Astrofestival is held at that planet, a different planet with a higher number, or one with a lower number. As long as he has enough fuel, he may choose to Astrojump again.

zh.ai: Astrodavid 生活在行星 $$$1$$$ 上。他的星舰具有 $$$J$$$ 的跳跃能力。为了从行星 $$$p$$$ 起飞，他选择一次位移为 $$$i$$$ 的星跃，使其满足 $$$1\le |i|\le J$$$、$$$1\le p+i\le N$$$，并且燃料储备至少为 $$$f_i$$$ 个单位。随后，他将降落在行星 $$$p+i$$$ 上，燃料储备减少 $$$f_i$$$ 个单位。在那里询问方向后，他会得知星际节是在该行星、编号更大的另一颗行星，还是编号更小的行星上举办。只要燃料充足，他就可以再次进行星跃。

segs.en: The first line contains two space-separated integers $$$N$$$ ($$$2\le N\le 4\,000$$$) and $$$J$$$ ($$$1\le J\le \frac N2$$$), the number of colonized planets and the jump power, respectively.

zh.ai: 第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $$$N$$$($$$2\le N\le 4\,000$$$)和 $$$J$$$($$$1\le J\le \frac N2$$$)，分别表示已殖民的星球数量和跳跃能力。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$J$$$ integers, the $$$i$$$'th of which is $$$f_i$$$, the fuel cost of jumping upward by $$$i$$$ planets.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$J$$$ 个整数，其中第 $$$i$$$ 个为 $$$f_i$$$，表示向上跳跃 $$$i$$$ 个星球所需的燃料消耗。

segs.en: The third line contains $$$J$$$ integers, the $$$i$$$'th of which is $$$f_{-i}$$$, the fuel cost of jumping downward by $$$i$$$ planets.

zh.ai: 第三行包含 $$$J$$$ 个整数，其中第 $$$i$$$ 个为 $$$f_{-i}$$$，表示向下跳跃 $$$i$$$ 个行星所需的燃料消耗。

segs.en: Output the minimum number of units of fuel that Astrodavid must buy to guarantee that he'll reach the festival, no matter where it's actually held.

zh.ai: 输出 Astrodavid 为保证无论节日实际在哪里举行都能到达而必须购买的最少燃料单位数。
